paths.description: The paths as asked, after removing ./ and making absolute paths repo-relative.

partners.description: The most partners listed per file.

degreeGuideline.description: The degree percentage that partners are marked against (cochange.minDegree).

path.description: The file's path at the analysed commit. A path renamed away is followed to its current name.

requested.description: The path as asked, when it differs from path.

exists.description: The path is in the tree at the analysed commit.

frequency.description: Logical changes touching the file in the analysis window.

recentRevisions.description: Of those, changes inside the recent window.

hotspotScore.description: Rank percentile of frequency times rank percentile of complexity, as in hotspots.

alongside.description: Files that change with this one: support at or above the configured minimum (too few shared changes to mean anything below it). Partners at or above the degree guideline come first, then the rest, each strongest confidence first.

confidence.description: Percent of changes to the briefed file that also touched this one.

reverseConfidence.description: Percent of changes to this file that also touched the briefed one.

aboveGuideline.description: Degree is at or above the degree guideline (cochange.minDegree).

alongsideNotShown.description: Partners with enough support that were cut by --partners.

note.description: Why the briefing is empty, when it is.
